tf_owners.odom_to_base_footprint: Super-LIO vehicle adapter (only after timestamped source-frame TF, measured extrinsic and covariance checks)

/lio/cloud_body.producer: not published by pinned Super-LIO; no body-frame cloud is synthesized
/lio/cloud_body.policy: requires a measured vehicle-frame adapter; direct frame relabel is forbidden

/lio/cloud_world.policy: source frame is never relabeled; stamped TF adapter required

/lio/vehicle_health.policy: OK requires verified transform, covariance and source health

/lio/odom_vehicle.producer: super_lio_vehicle_adapter after timestamped world->odom TF and measured IMU->base checks
/lio/odom_vehicle.policy: source frame mismatch, missing TF, missing measured extrinsic, unknown health or covariance withholds output

/research/road_reference.producer: active_road_map persisted-version/path boundary (external reference input required)

/research/local_obstacle_grid.producer: research_local_obstacle_grid node from /lio/cloud_odom (timestamped TF adapter required)

/research/road_evidence.consumer: active_road_evidence; invalid or unknown store blocks persistence

/research/road_events.policy: observed geometry is not promoted to traversed

/research/observation_goal.producer: active_observation; actual EGO candidate query and fresh commit query
/research/observation_goal.policy: fresh RTK Bool and allowed original mode, health/covariance, TF integrity, permission and full footprint hard filters

/lio/cloud_odom.policy: original obstacle height window; acquisition-time source-world-to-odom transform

/research/tf_integrity.policy: one fresh dynamic GID per protected child; protected static edge permanently blocks until TF buffers restarted

/localization_authority/mode.policy: fresh RTK_AUTHORITATIVE or RTK_REACQUIRING only; LIO_BRIDGE remains denied even if legacy Bool is true

/research/road_graph_updates.consumer: sole evidence writer; prior_version and measured UUID references required; stale/unanchored increments withheld globally

/research/road_evidence_ack.content: accepted measurement UUID only; enables idempotent sensor retransmission

/lio/cloud_filtered_world.policy: original regular height window along gravity relative to source IMU origin

/lio/cloud_filtered_body.policy: same regular points transformed with acquisition-matched world-to-IMU rigid pose; not vehicle body calibration

serial.physical_sink_condition: execution_mode:=live and enable_serial:=true; replay/shadow never attach production serial

trajectory_progress: generated_at retained between geometry replans; fresh validated TTL heartbeat; candidate query never publishes control
